chunks: That God may recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and punish the hypocrites or relent towards them, as He will. God is surely forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of God revealing the truth about the hypocrites according to Surah Al-Ahzab?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate divine justice where truthfulness (sidq) is the hallmark of true believers, while hypocrisy (nifaq) is exposed through the unfolding of events. It emphasizes that God's punishment or forgiveness of the hypocrites is not arbitrary but rooted in His attribute of being All-Forgiving and Merciful, offering a path to repentance even for those who concealed their disbelief.
